title: Java serialized object stream
summary: A Java serialized object stream begins with the 2-byte magic 0xAC 0xED followed by the stream version 0x00 0x05.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Followed by TC_OBJECT (0x73) + class descriptor + field data.
Deserialization of untrusted streams is a known RCE vector (e.g. Apache Commons Collections).
